text:
mira: idea - split config risk into three axes: behavioral, economic, privacy. each axis maps to approver groups and can influence default canary size.

kevin: love the axes. do we compute them or rely on heuristics?

jamal: telemetry-first. behavioral=p50 impact estimate, economic=quota/cost delta, privacy=egress/region changes. weightable per-team.

mira: mapping: score <0.2 auto, 0.2-0.5 owner, >0.5 owner+SRE+Security. default dry-run for privacy=true.

olivia: console UI: stacked three-bar indicator, tooltip explains triggers and shows suggested canary plan. include tenant-slice option.

ops-bot: PRECHECK: schema ok. simulated: p50_delta=7.8%, quota_delta=1.4x, privacy_flag=true, risk_score=0.61, suggested_canary=0.05%, approvers=["SRE","Security"].

kevin: add machine-approver for repeat safe ops but restrict to risk_score<0.15 and privacy=false.

jamal: telemetry gates for rollback: p50 > baseline*1.4, errors +1pp AND >3x relative, quota > predicted*1.6. windows: 15m for latency, 1h for errors.

mira: API v2 fields: risk_axes, risk_score, canary_plan (steps), dry_run_fraction, revert_token, audit_reason. logs immutable to secure-audit.

olivia: I'll draft microcopy for privacy tooltip: example + dry-run note.

ops-bot: ACTION: infra-telemetry issue created to add canary preview snapshots.

kevin: ok to proceed? react :thumbsup: if yes.

mira: thanks all, will update PR with axes, tenant-sliced canaries, and stacked-bar UI.
